{{ElectionsOH}}
The '''2022 Ohio State Treasurer election''' was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the [[Ohio State Treasurer]], concurrently with elections to the [[2022 United States Senate election in Ohio|United States Senate]], [[2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Ohio|U.S. House of Representatives]], [[2022 Ohio gubernatorial election|governor]], and other [[2022 Ohio elections|state]] and [[2022 United States elections#Local elections|local]] elections. Primary elections were held on May 3, 2022.<ref>{{Cite web |date=June 30, 2022 |title=2022 State Primary Election Dates and Filing Deadlines |url=https://www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/2022-state-primary-election-dates-and-filing-deadlines |access-date=November 20, 2025 |website=National Conference of State Legislatures}}</ref>

Incumbent [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] treasurer [[Robert Sprague]] ran for re-election to a second term in office against [[Marion, Ohio|Marion]] mayor Scott Schertzer.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Kasler |first=Karen |date=October 19, 2022 |title=Ohio Election 2022: Robert Sprague and Scott Schertzer run for Ohio Treasurer |url=https://www.statenews.org/government-politics/2022-10-19/ohio-election-2022-robert-sprague-and-scott-schertzer-run-for-ohio-treasurer |access-date=November 20, 2025 |website=The Statehouse News Bureau}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Staver |first=Anna |date=October 10, 2022 |title=Election 2022: Who is running for state treasurer in Ohio? |url=https://www.dispatch.com/story/news/politics/elections/2022/10/11/who-is-running-for-state-treasurer-in-ohio/69528530007/ |access-date=November 20, 2025 |website=The Columbus Dispatch}}</ref> Sprague comfortably won re-election, expanding on his 2018 margin of victory.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Staver |first=Anna |date=November 8, 2022 |title=Ohio Treasurer Robert Sprague wins race for reelection |url=https://www.dispatch.com/story/news/politics/elections/2022/11/09/robert-sprague-wins-race-for-reelection-as-state-treasurer/69606194007/ |access-date=November 20, 2025 |website=The Columbus Dispatch}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Exner |first=Rich |date=December 7, 2018 |title=Final Ohio 2018 election results: Mike DeWine beat Richard Cordray, 50.4% to 46.7% with largest turnout in Ohio history for a governor’s race |url=https://www.cleveland.com/datacentral/2018/12/final-ohio-2018-election-results-mike-dewine-beat-richard-cordray-504-to-467-with-largest-turnout-in-ohio-history-for-a-governors-race.html |access-date=November 20, 2025 |website=cleveland.com}}</ref> During the campaign, Sprague led in fundraising against Schertzer.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Provance |first=Jim |date=October 8, 2022 |title=Marion mayor seeks to unseat state treasurer |url=https://www.toledoblade.com/local/politics/2022/10/08/schertzer-state-treasurer-marion-mayor/stories/20221006147 |access-date=November 20, 2025 |website=The Toledo Blade}}</ref>
